day_shape: 72 items: four IDF soldiers killed in Kfar Tebnit with 150+ strikes on Hezbollah targets across Lebanon, reported 4pm Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire, Khamenei message on Iran-US MOU, Swiss talks postponed, UK aid pledge to Lebanon.

threads.label: IDF strikes and Lebanon casualties
threads.summary: The IDF announced four soldiers killed, including a 52nd Battalion commander, and five wounded in Hezbollah attacks at Kfar Tebnit, with strikes on 150+ targets across southern Lebanon and the Beqaa. IRIB claimed around 50 Lebanese were killed, and Defence Minister Katz said troops would remain in the southern security zone.

threads.label: Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire reporting
threads.summary: Times of Israel and IRIB cited a senior US official telling Reuters Israel and Hezbollah agreed to a ceasefire starting 4pm local time. Defa Press cited CNN reporting that Washington told Iran Israel's Lebanon strikes would not intensify, and CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper issued a statement.

threads.label: Hezbollah leadership messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB quoted Hezbollah secretary-general Sheikh Naim Qassem at a Muharram mourning ceremony at Nasrallah's shrine vowing to expel Israel from Lebanese soil and meet weapons with weapons. Qassem said the enemy's plot to eliminate Hezbollah had been foiled and that heavy losses were trivial compared to surrender.

threads.label: Iran-US MOU and postponed Swiss talks
threads.summary: IRIB published Khamenei's full message to Iranians on the memorandum of understanding signed between the presidents of Iran and America, with Khamenei's office adding that future in-person negotiations would not mean accepting the enemy's view. The Swiss Foreign Ministry and Iran's Foreign Ministry said the Switzerland meeting was postponed, while Defa Press described unfreezing currency reserves as a key clause.

threads.label: Iran diplomacy and Hormuz denial
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bagheri dismissed reports of a Strait of Hormuz closure as baseless, and FM Araghchi told Pakistan's foreign minister Washington bore responsibility to uphold ceasefires including in Lebanon. IRIB reported the UK, China, Russia and Pakistan called at the UN Security Council for unconditional humanitarian access to Gaza.

threads.label: Humanitarian response and UK pledge
threads.summary: UK Development Minister Jenny Chapman visited Lebanon with French and Qatari counterparts and announced new humanitarian support. UN OCHA published a three-month Middle East impact report covering March–May 2026, and the ICRC delivered 18 tonnes of supplies to the Iranian Red Crescent Society.

threads.label: Iran energy, sanctions and IRGC activity
threads.summary: Tanker Trackers reported Iran exported nearly 18 million barrels (~$1.44bn) of crude over five days, while Senator Tom Cotton warned removing oil sanctions would earn Tehran ~$200m a day; Iran International examined Iran's Qatar power-grid plan against domestic shortages. IRIB said a cyber attack disrupted four Iranian banks, and Jerusalem Post cited Reuters reporting IRGC has set up secretive cells in Iraq to target Gulf states hosting US forces.
